=== enter between braces
--- before
int main(void) {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
int main(void) {
    ¦
}

=== electric closer
--- before
void f(void) {
    g();
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
void f(void) {
    g();
}¦

=== autoclose bracket
--- before
int a¦;
--- keys
[3
--- after
int a[3¦];

=== no autoclose in string
--- before
char *s = "x¦";
--- keys
(
--- after
char *s = "x(¦";

=== char quote
--- before
char c = ¦;
--- keys
'a
--- after
char c = 'a¦';

=== surround
--- before
x = «a»;
--- keys
(
--- after
x = («a»);

=== line comment
--- before
«int a;
int b;»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«// int a;
// int b;»

=== block comment
--- before
int ¦a;
--- keys
<bc>
--- after
/* int ¦a; */

=== indent after open paren
--- before
f(a,¦
--- keys
<enter>b
--- after
f(a,
    b¦

=== backspace pair
--- before
x = ¦;
--- keys
(<bs>
--- after
x = ¦;

=== multi cursor type
--- before
a¦
b¦
c¦
--- keys
()
--- after
a()¦
b()¦
c()¦
